addressed.change: Added upper-bound check so months > 360 raises ValueError
Reject principals with exponent < -2 (e.g. "100.000") instead of numeric quantize comparison, and quantize principal under enlarged precision so large valid principals are accepted

Perform principal cent-quantization under precision covering its digits (and schedule/total maths with sufficient precision) so large valid principals no longer raise InvalidOperation under default context

claims.title: Principal with more than 2 decimal places is accepted when the extra digits are trailing zeroes
Valid large principal is rejected during cent quantization
